name: Check SSL Capabilities
description: Makes sure the SSL proxy (nginx + iptables) can run: an unprivileged container already holds net_admin in its user namespace, so nothing is added. Removes an 'lxc.cap.keep: net_admin' line written by earlier versions — lxc.cap.keep keeps ONLY the listed capabilities and broke iptables-legacy (cap_net_raw) and nginx (cap_chown) for root apps.

commands.name: Add SSL Capabilities
commands.description: Verify net_admin is available; drop the obsolete restrictive cap.keep line
